title: USB music playback and CarPlay access
summary: Feedback centers on missing USB music playback and reliance on phone or CarPlay connections for audio access, with many examples stating the limitation without a clear overall sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews still mention frustration that music cannot be played directly from USB and that owners may need to use an iPhone instead.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe inability to play music from USB media and occasional Apple CarPlay or phone connection failures that block navigation or music use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly state that the USB sockets are charge-only or that USB sticks and drives are not supported for music playback, with some mentions of CarPlay irritation or disconnections.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are terse problem statements, so the reasons behind the missing USB playback support are not explained.
The topic combines direct USB media limitations with separate CarPlay or phone connection issues, which are related but not identical subjects.
Many examples are assigned undetermined sentiment, limiting how specifically the sentiment patterns can be interpreted from the sample.
